messages.author: 4184023bb084c468
messages.subject: errors with knitr 1.5 on windows
parts:
Hi,
Several bioconductor packages are failing due to this.

Example:

R CMD build KEGGREST
[...]
* creating vignettes ... ERROR
Warning in par("page") : "page" is not a graphical parameter
Quitting from lines 7-9 (KEGGREST-vignette.Rmd)
Error: processing vignette 'KEGGREST-vignette.Rmd' failed with diagnostics:
invalid argument type
Execution halted

If I try running knit() on the vignette, i get:

> knit("KEGGREST-vignette.Rmd")


processing file: KEGGREST-vignette.Rmd
  |.                                                                |   2%
  ordinary text without R code

  |...                                                              |   4%
label: setup (with options)
List of 1
 $ echo: logi FALSE

Warning in par("page") : "page" is not a graphical parameter
Quitting from lines 7-9 (KEGGREST-vignette.Rmd)
Error in !par("page") : invalid argument type


The contents of line 7-10 of the vignette are:

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
library(knitr)
options(width=80)
```



I can purl and then source the vignette just fine, but when I try and knit (or R CMD build it) I get this.

Any ideas?

> sessionInfo()
R version 3.0.1 (2013-05-16)
Platform: i386-w64-mingw32/i386 (32-bit)

locale:
[1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252
[2] LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252
[3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252
[4] LC_NUMERIC=C
[5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base

other attached packages:
[1] knitr_1.5            BiocInstaller_1.10.3

loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
[1] evaluate_0.5  formatR_0.9   stringr_0.6.2 tools_3.0.1

Thanks,
Dan

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] errors with knitr 1.5 on windows
parts:
Sorry that is due to a bug in the evaluate package, which has been
fixed shortly after I uploaded knitr 1.5. A similar report is here:
http://stackoverflow.com/q/19071463/559676

Before evaluate 0.5.1 appears on CRAN, evaluate 0.5 has to be built
from source under Windows if you use R 3.0.1. R 3.0.2 won't have this
problem.

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
